name: slide_lint
title: Lint Slidev deck
description: Lints the whole talk-dir (pages/**/*.md and slides.md) and returns the list of violations. The call itself succeeds even with violations; outcome is violations when any are found.

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir to lint. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

event.description: slide.lint.done or slide.lint.violations on success, slide.lint.error on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

dir.description: Absolute path of the linted talk-dir (success only)

outcome.description: clean (no violations), violations (some found), no-target (no file to lint) (success only)

file.description: Path relative to the talk-dir (absolute when outside it)

skippedSymlinkDirectories.description: Symlinked directories under pages/ that were not linted (relative to the talk-dir) (success only)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
